description:
Riviera Residences – Premium Family Apartments in the Heart of Trivandrum

Riviera Residences is a newly constructed, semi-furnished premium rental apartment complex designed for families seeking comfort, safety, convenience, and modern living. Wheelchair accessible entrance, toilet and parking provided. Strategically located in the heart of Trivandrum, the property offers excellent connectivity to major educational institutions, healthcare facilities, transportation hubs, and employment centres.

#Prime Location

•Trivandrum Medical College – 200 metres away

•Medical College Bus Stand – 100 metres walking distance

•Four reputed schools within a 1 km radius:

•Arya Central School

•St. Mary's Higher Secondary School, Pattom

•Pattom Girls Higher Secondary School

•Kendriya Vidyalaya

•KIMSHEALTH Super Speciality Hospital – 4 km

•Trivandrum International Airport – 6 km

•Technopark Phase I & II – within 10 km

•Located just 50 metres from the main highway with private road access

#Apartment Features & Amenities

•Private balcony for every apartment

•Elevator access

•Dedicated car parking and bike parking for each tenant

•Electric vehicle charging facility

•24/7 security and CCTV surveillance

•Safe and family-friendly environment

•Continuous supply of clean drinking water through well water, borewell, and corporation line water

•Individual electricity and water meter for each apartment

•Well-maintained premises with regular upkeep

•On-call technical support, including electrician, plumber, and carpenter services when required

#Pet PolicyLimited 

Pets are permitted. However, dogs are not allowed in order to maintain a child-friendly environment within the premises.

Transparent Rental PolicyAll amenities and maintenance services are included in the rent. No additional maintenance charges are levied on tenants.

Riviera Residences offers a secure, peaceful, and modern lifestyle, making it an ideal ready-to-move-in home for families looking for quality living in Trivandrum.
